theme.en: AI Infrastructure Pushes Beyond the GPU
theme.zh: AI基础设施正在超越GPU本身

dek.en: This cycle’s announcements move the bottleneck outward: 2nm capacity, memory tiers, power, materials, and deployment software. Earnings and roadmaps show AI demand spreading across the semiconductor stack.
dek.zh: 本轮消息表明，瓶颈正从GPU向外延伸至2nm产能、存储层级、电力、材料和部署软件。业绩与路线图显示，AI需求正覆盖整个半导体技术栈。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: Ambiq adds open-source profiling for Apollo edge-AI SoCs
title.zh: Ambiq为Apollo边缘AI SoC推出开源性能分析工具

summary.en: Ambiq has introduced heliaPROFILER, an open-source tool for profiling AI applications on its Apollo SoCs. It provides cycle-accurate visibility into execution, memory use, and energy, helping developers identify the practical limits of edge models before deployment.
summary.zh: Ambiq推出了heliaPROFILER，这是一款面向Apollo SoC上AI应用的开源性能分析工具。该工具提供对执行周期、内存使用和能耗的周期精度可见性，使开发者能在部署前识别边缘模型的实际限制。

title.en: Japanese distributor signals 20%–40% higher Gigabyte GPU prices
title.zh: 日本经销商预警Gigabyte显卡价格或上涨20%至40%

summary.en: Japanese distributor CFD Sales has indicated that new Gigabyte graphics-card orders could carry price increases of 20% to 40% this month. The warning shows that component costs and supply conditions can still reach buyers even as accelerator demand dominates industry attention.
summary.zh: 日本经销商CFD Sales表示，本月起新的Gigabyte显卡订单价格可能上调20%至40%。这一预警表明，即使行业焦点集中在AI加速器，元器件成本和供需状况仍会传导至消费级渠道。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: TSMC reportedly targets 100,000 2nm wafers per month by end-2026
title.zh: 报道称台积电瞄准2026年底前月产10万片2nm晶圆

summary.en: TSMC is reported to be targeting monthly output of 100,000 2nm wafers by the end of 2026. Reaching that level would make leading-edge wafer availability a major input to the next AI and premium-mobile cycles, while increasing demand for materials and advanced packaging capacity.
summary.zh: 报道称，台积电瞄准在2026年底前实现2nm晶圆月产10万片。若达到这一规模，先进制程晶圆供给将成为下一轮AI和高端移动产品周期的重要变量，同时也会提升对材料和先进封装产能的需求。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: SK hynix and SanDisk introduce an HBF standard with up to 512GB capacity
title.zh: SK hynix与SanDisk发布HBF标准，容量最高支持512GB

summary.en: SK hynix and SanDisk have unveiled the first High Bandwidth Flash, or HBF, standard, with stacks supporting up to 512GB. HBF targets a higher-capacity tier for AI model weights while HBM remains the closer low-latency tier; ecosystem adoption will determine its rack-scale value.
summary.zh: SK hynix与SanDisk发布了首个High Bandwidth Flash（HBF）标准，单堆栈容量最高可达512GB。HBF旨在为AI模型权重提供更高容量的存储层级，而HBM继续承担更近端的低时延角色；其机架级价值仍取决于生态系统采用。

title.en: Equipment & Materials
title.zh: 设备与材料

title.en: Air Liquide highlights an ultra-pure-gas complex in Dresden
title.zh: Air Liquide披露德累斯顿超高纯气体综合设施

summary.en: Air Liquide has highlighted an ultra-pure-gas complex in Dresden, adding supply-chain infrastructure around a major European semiconductor manufacturing cluster. Ultra-pure process gases are qualified fab inputs, so local capacity matters for production continuity and regional fab expansion.
summary.zh: Air Liquide披露了位于德累斯顿的一座超高纯气体综合设施，为欧洲重要半导体制造集群补充供应链基础设施。超高纯制程气体属于需要认证的晶圆厂投入品，因此本地供应能力关系到生产连续性以及区域晶圆厂的扩产。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: China tightens chip-design rules and IP-protection requirements
title.zh: 中国收紧芯片设计规则并提高知识产权保护门槛

summary.en: A new report says China is tightening chip-design rules and raising the bar for intellectual-property protection. Design houses and IP vendors face compliance work alongside technical development, potentially changing how domestic supply chains document and license reusable blocks.
summary.zh: 一则新报道指出，中国正在收紧芯片设计规则并提高知识产权保护门槛。设计公司和IP供应商除推进技术开发外还将面临更多合规工作，这可能影响国内供应链如何记录和授权可复用IP模块。

title.en: Earnings & Markets
title.zh: 业绩与市场

title.en: AMD data-center revenue doubles year on year as gaming falls 31%
title.zh: AMD数据中心营收同比翻倍，游戏业务下滑31%

summary.en: AMD reported record second-quarter revenue, with its data-center business doubling from a year earlier, while gaming revenue fell 31%. The divergence shows how AI infrastructure is remaking the company’s mix while demand outside data centers remains sensitive to pricing and product cycles.
summary.zh: AMD公布了创纪录的第二季度营收，其中数据中心业务同比翻倍，而游戏业务营收下降31%。这一分化说明AI基础设施正在重塑公司的收入结构，同时数据中心以外的需求仍对定价和产品周期高度敏感。

title.en: Lattice reports record Q2 revenue of $201.1 million
title.zh: Lattice公布创纪录的第二季度营收2.011亿美元

summary.en: Lattice Semiconductor reported record second-quarter revenue of $201.1 million. Results from a low-power FPGA supplier offer a read on demand beyond GPUs, where programmable logic serves edge processing, networking, control, and embedded acceleration.
summary.zh: Lattice Semiconductor公布第二季度营收达到创纪录的2.011亿美元。作为低功耗FPGA供应商，其业绩为GPU以外的需求提供了观察窗口；可编程逻辑被用于边缘处理、网络、控制和嵌入式加速。

theme.en: Making Compute Systems More Physically Aware
theme.zh: 让计算系统更具物理感知能力

dek.en: This week’s papers connect hardware efficiency to physical constraints: photonic loss, transistor hotspots, three-dimensional atom transport, and layout power. The common goal is to move optimization closer to device and system behavior.
dek.zh: 本周论文将硬件效率与物理约束联系起来，包括光子损耗、晶体管热点、三维原子搬运和版图功耗。它们的共同目标是让优化更贴近器件和系统行为。

title.en: Devices & Process
title.zh: 器件与工艺

title.en: Foundry-compatible silicon-photonics MEMS optical switch
title.zh: 兼容晶圆厂工艺的硅光MEMS光开关

papers.authors: Arkadev Roy, Daniel Klawson, Jianheng Luo, et al.

summary.en: The authors demonstrate a C-band silicon-photonics MEMS switch made in a zero-change foundry-compatible flow with BEOL post-processing. It reports more than 30 dB extinction, under 1.5 dB insertion loss, and roughly 20 nW static power, a strong combination if endurance and array integration hold up.
summary.zh: 作者展示了一种采用零改动、兼容晶圆厂流程并结合BEOL后处理的C波段硅光MEMS光开关。该器件报告超过30 dB消光比、低于1.5 dB插入损耗和约20 nW静态功耗；若耐久性和阵列集成表现可靠，这一组合颇具吸引力。

title.en: Active passivation steers hotspots in GaN transistors
title.zh: 主动钝化调控GaN晶体管热点位置

papers.authors: Yicheng Wei, Sihang Liu, Zimu Jiang, et al.

summary.en: This work uses active-passivation length to shift the hotspot in GaN transistors from the gate edge to the drain-side passivation edge. Micro-Raman thermography and multiphysics simulation tie the movement to peak electric field and localized Joule heating, offering a lever for power-device thermal reliability.
summary.zh: 该研究通过改变主动钝化层长度，将GaN晶体管热点从栅极边缘转移至漏极侧钝化层边缘。微拉曼测温和多物理场仿真将这一迁移与峰值电场及局部焦耳热相关联，为功率器件热可靠性提供了设计手段。

title.en: AI Accelerators & Compute-in-Memory
title.zh: AI加速器与存算一体

title.en: FPGA partial reconfiguration for LLM nonlinear functions
title.zh: 利用FPGA局部重构实现LLM非线性函数计算

papers.authors: Roger Morales-Monge, Nazareth Jimenez-Chacon, Jose Gabriel Villalobos-Alvarado, et al.

summary.en: The paper uses FPGA partial reconfiguration to swap piecewise-linear exponential and sigmoid units for LLM acceleration. Compared with a static design holding both operators, it reports up to 43% fewer LUTs and up to 50% fewer flip-flops, BRAMs, and DSPs, subject to reconfiguration overhead in real workloads.
summary.zh: 论文利用FPGA局部重构来切换面向LLM加速的分段线性指数和sigmoid单元。相对于同时固定集成两种算子的静态设计，它报告最多减少43%的LUT，并最多减少50%的触发器、BRAM和DSP，但真实工作负载仍要考虑重构开销。

title.en: Celty co-designs a sparse GPU path for LLM decoding
title.zh: Celty为LLM解码协同设计稀疏GPU执行路径

summary.en: Celty targets single-user LLM decoding with both pruned weights and runtime activation sparsity, a case conventional GPU kernels handle poorly. Its compressed format, kernel, and proposed SIMT core work together to avoid index reconstruction and memory traffic; the benefit will depend on attainable sparsity and hardware adoption.
summary.zh: Celty面向同时具有剪枝权重和运行时激活稀疏性的单用户LLM解码，这类工作负载通常难以被传统GPU内核高效处理。其压缩格式、内核和拟议SIMT核心协同设计，以避免索引重建和多余内存访问；实际收益取决于可实现稀疏度及硬件采用。

title.en: Electronic Design Automation
title.zh: 电子设计自动化

title.en: Fovea brings physical constraints into wafer-scale design exploration
title.zh: Fovea将物理约束纳入晶圆级设计空间探索

papers.authors: Jinxi Li, Huizheng Wang, Jinyi Deng, et al.

summary.en: Fovea formulates wafer-scale architecture exploration around coupled constraints including reticle compliance, wafer tiling, die area, die-to-die capability, and placement. It calibrates disagreement between low-cost and reference evaluators before refinement, reducing the risk that a fixed coarse shortlist misses full-fidelity winners.
summary.zh: Fovea围绕光罩合规、晶圆平铺、芯粒面积、芯粒间互连能力和布局等耦合约束来构建设计空间。它在细化候选方案前校准低成本评估器与参考评估器之间的偏差，从而降低固定粗筛名单漏掉全保真优胜设计的风险。

title.en: Quantum Computing
title.zh: 量子计算

title.en: Piqasso compiles for three-dimensional neutral-atom computers
title.zh: Piqasso面向三维中性原子量子计算机进行编译

papers.authors: Chen Huang, Zhemin Zhang, Zhao Zhang, et al.

summary.en: Piqasso compiles for three-dimensional neutral-atom arrays by separating storage, entanglement, and readout into layers, then routing atoms with vertical hops and multi-AOD scheduling. Across 34 circuits it reports 2.1× less transport distance, up to 7.3× faster execution, 2.2× higher movement fidelity, and 1.8× fewer serialized transport rounds than a planar baseline.
summary.zh: Piqasso面向三维中性原子阵列进行编译，将存储、纠缠和读出分置于不同层，并通过垂直搬运和多AOD调度完成原子路由。在34个电路上，它相对于平面基线报告2.1倍更短的搬运距离、最高7.3倍更快执行、2.2倍更高移动保真度和1.8倍更少的串行搬运轮次。
